```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidygenclust)
library(resrepo)
library(ggplot2)
library(mclust)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_b_supervised/"
```

This script uses supervised ADMIXTURE @alexanderFastModelbasedEstimation2009 to estimate ancestry proportions in Malagasy populations, using Borneo and Mozambique as reference populations.

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt",
    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld"
  )
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

# Subset mad_bor_g1000_sum

```{r}
moz_pop <- unique(grep("^Mozambique",
  mad_bor_g1000_sum$population,
  value = TRUE
))

pops <- c(
  "Borneo", moz_pop, "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego",
  "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"
)

mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(population %in% pops)

mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub %>% group_by(population)
```

# Write plink files

```{r eval = FALSE}
gt_as_plink(mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub,
  file = "../data/intermediate/admixture/admixture_supervised_subset",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

# Write .pop file 

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub %>%
  mutate(Region = "-")
mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub %>%
  mutate(Region = case_when(
    population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor") ~ "Asian",
    population %in% moz_pop ~ "African",
    TRUE ~ "-"
  ))

```

```{r  eval = FALSE}
write.table(mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub$Region,
  file = "../data/intermediate/admixture/admixture_supervised_subset.pop",
  row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)
```

# Run admixture

```{bash eval = FALSE}
cd ~/Git/malagasy_diversity/code
bash s05_admixture_supervised.sh
```

# Read output

```{r}
predicted_q <- read_q_files("../data/intermediate/admixture")
```

# Plot

```{r}
# rename populations
mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub$population <-
  ifelse(mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub$population %in% moz_pop,
    "Mozambique", mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub$population
  )

# rename "Sakalava Tsimihety" and "Diego"
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(population = case_when(
    population == "Sakalava_Tsimihety" ~ "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
    population == "Diego" ~ "Diego Mixed",
    TRUE ~ population
  ))

autoplot(get_q_matrix(predicted_q, k = 2, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub,
  annotate_group = TRUE, arrange_by_group = TRUE,
  arrange_by_indiv = TRUE, reorder_within_groups = TRUE
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "Admixture_supervised_malagasy.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
q_tibble <- augment(
  get_q_matrix(predicted_q, k = 2, run = 1),
  mad_bor_g1000_sum_sub
)
q_tibble <- q_tibble %>% group_by(population)
q_tibble <- q_tibble %>% filter(!population %in% c("Borneo", "Mozambique"))

p1 <- ggplot(
  q_tibble,
  aes(
    x = .Q2, y = population,
    fill = population, colour = population
  )
) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, trim = FALSE) +
  labs(
    fill = "Population", colour = "Population",
    x = "African ancestry Proportion (.Q1)", y = NULL
  ) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.05, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position.inside = c(0.15, 0.75),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Betsileo" = "#1B9E77",
      "Betsimisaraka" = "#D95F02",
      "Diego Mixed" = "#7570B3",
      "Merina" = "#E7298A",
      "Mikea" = "#66A61E",
      "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = "#E6AB02",
      "Temoro" = "#A6761D",
      "Vezo" = "#666666"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Betsileo" = "#1B9E77",
      "Betsimisaraka" = "#D95F02",
      "Diego Mixed" = "#7570B3",
      "Merina" = "#E7298A",
      "Mikea" = "#66A61E",
      "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = "#E6AB02",
      "Temoro" = "#A6761D",
      "Vezo" = "#666666"
    )
  )
p1

ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "Afr_anc_violin_all_pops.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```


# mclust to confirm optimum number of clusters

```{r}
classes_optimum <- Mclust(
  data = q_tibble_merina$.Q2,
  modelNames = "V"
)

clust_classes <- clustCombi(object = classes_optimum, q_tibble_merina$.Q2)

optimum <- clustCombiOptim(clust_classes)
optimum$numClusters.combi
```
